item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your day has a lot of structure, with early mornings, midday check-ins, and a late evening. That's exactly when water gets forgotten. Dehydration quietly hurts focus, mood, and patience, and those are the things you're trying to protect. Thirst is a late signal, so don't wait for it. Drink before you're asked to think hard, and keep water within reach. Your action: drink a full glass of water right now.
